nodes.label: Alpine.js Cart Store ($store.cart)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for cart state persisted to localStorage, registered before Alpine.start() in app.js, accessible from every Blade component without a backend dependency in Plan 2.

nodes.label: Customisation Drawer (cart-drawer.blade.php)
nodes.rationale: Right-side slide-in panel (translate-x-full to translate-x-0) controlled entirely by Alpine store; included once in the app layout so every menu page inherits it without re-rendering.

nodes.label: Kitchen Notes Quick-Pick Chips
nodes.rationale: Toggle chips (recommended over append-only) so chips can be deselected cleanly; selected chips sync to textarea as comma-separated text; typing in textarea clears chip state.

nodes.label: Admin Auth Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: Minimal auth needed before any admin page review: users.role column migration + AdminUserSeeder + AuthController redirecting admin to /admin and customers to /home.

nodes.label: Admin Layout with Alpine.js Drawer
nodes.rationale: Separate admin layout extending the same Vite/Tailwind assets; sidebar uses Alpine.store('adminNav') for mobile drawer; industrial-gray design tokens added to tailwind.config.js.

nodes.label: Database Schema (Plan 4)
nodes.rationale: TDD-first approach; categories/menu_items/base_ingredients/toppings/allergens/delivery_zones normalised schema. Alpine cart's hardcoded baseIngredients/allToppings replaced by API calls in this plan.

nodes.label: Stripe Checkout Session Flow
nodes.rationale: Cart serialised from Alpine localStorage into hidden form field at POST /checkout; prices re-validated against DB before creating Order + OrderItems; Stripe webhook provides belt-and-suspenders status update alongside success-redirect.

nodes.label: Pusher WebSocket Broadcasting
nodes.rationale: OrderStatusUpdated event broadcasts on private-order.{id} (customer) and private-admin.orders (kitchen/admin); defaults to log driver so tests pass without real Pusher keys.

nodes.label: Promotions & Settings Key-Value Store
nodes.rationale: Three independent features sharing the same migration→model→CRUD pattern. Settings use a key-value table with a static Setting::get/set helper to avoid code deploys for store info changes.

nodes.label: cPanel Shared Hosting Deployment
nodes.rationale: Frontend assets built locally before deploy to avoid Node.js dependency on cPanel; public folder symlinked to public_html; Stripe webhook registered after go-live with signing secret in .env.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting (throttle middleware)
nodes.rationale: Laravel built-in throttle middleware applied directly to POST login/register/checkout routes — no additional packages needed.

nodes.label: Menu Item Image Upload
nodes.rationale: Public disk storage in storage/app/public/menu/ served via storage/ symlink; old image cleaned up on replacement to avoid orphaned files.
